title: Has anyone ever had a similar vibe like this?
content: This is an opening scene from Wong Kar Wai's legendary movie, Fallen Angels. I've always had this kind of ambiance in my dreams even before I discovered the film (or the backrooms) and there's also an exact place like this in the mall world. I mentioned my brief experience [here.](https://www.reddit.com/r/TheMallWorld/comments/1o5fz4l/comment/nj96emd/?context=3&utm_source=share&utm_medium=mweb3x&utm_name=mweb3xcss&utm_term=1&utm_content=share_button) Does anyone else relate?
